Nina (Finance): Invoice 100123 (Lumina Therapy) ACH failed: bank returns 'account number format invalid'. Amount $15,200. Customer says treasury entered account with dashes. Thoughts?
Rory (Billing Ops): Which gateway id?
Nina (Finance): gw_evt_54b1c — code=invalid_account_number, message=account number has invalid characters
billing-bot: Payment failed event logged for lumina-therapy, method=ach, last4=****4321
Rory (Billing Ops): Microdeposits never verified. If customer corrects account (no dashes) we can re-initiate microdeposits. Recommend don't retry auto to avoid NACHA rejects.
Sam (CS): I'm on with treasury now. They can resend ACH details corrected within 1 hour or wire tonight. Prefer ACH to avoid wire fees.
Nina (Finance): For <$25k no director sign-off needed. If they pick wire, ask for remittance screenshot and PO. For ACH, require they confirm legal name + re-submit routing/account (no formatting chars).
Lena (Finance Dir): FYI noted. Run standard fraud checks on account if new bank.
Rory (Billing Ops): Created ticket #4110, hold placed on invoice 100123, failure_code=invalid_account_number, attempts=0, next_action=await_corrected_details.
Sam (CS): Treasury will resend cleaned account tonight. I'll DM the details to Rory when received.
Nina (Finance): Good. Once ACH verified, proceed with microdeposits flow. If wire chosen, collect PO + remittance and mark invoice pending-wire. :+1:
